page.overview:
Who is Stanley?

Stanley is the protagonist of Fazbear Frights 3: 1:35AM's second story, Room for One More. He is a lonely man who comes across a strange ballerina doll while working as a security guard in a secretive underground facility.

Stanley is short and overweight, and he's inherited his father's receding hairline. He normally wears his security uniform and his shiny badge.

When the Minireenas start entering Stanley, he gets sickly gray skin, bloodshot eyes with dark shadows under them, a bleeding throat, and numb, swollen limbs. He also ends up with a stubble on his jaw and chin as he does not trust himself with his swollen limbs to shave. It gets to a point where Stanley has to wear a plain white T-shirt to work as his uniform is torn up.

Stanley is very sad and lonely due to his girlfriend, Amber, breaking up with him. His big appetite and love of eating has turned into emotional eating after the break up, and he loses his motivation and starts caring less. Stanley can be rather stubborn and uses the passing of his father to justify his fear of doctors. He is also easily amused, especially by childish things, and in his loneliness begins speaking to inanimate objects. Stanley often broods over his current life, which makes him vulnerable. He doesn’t usually cry and hides his moments of weakness from others out of embarrassment.
